revision_budget.note: Historical contract values are preserved. The active integration lead explicitly requested the continuation documented below; this is not runtime approval.

continuation_request.reason: Align the arm to GuardRig20 exact shoulder/elbow/wrist interfaces, rebuild a continuous closed padded sleeve and original extensor couter, and deliver an assembly-ready candidate after the prior visual failure.
continuation_request.scope_note: This records the active task continuation; it does not imply prior candidate approval or runtime approval.

source_truth.concept_use: Proportion and silver steel, muted brass, deep blue cloth vocabulary only.
source_truth.geometry: Original analytic authored control cages and low-detail output meshes. No old Quadri face or vertex is copied.
source_truth.arm_axis: GuardRig20 right arm interfaces: shoulder=[0.2537,0,1.3741], elbow=[0.3513,0,1.1009], wrist=[0.4294,0,0.8472]. Front=+Y. Each segment uses a perpendicular local frame with v=normalize(segmentAxis cross projectedFront).
source_truth.legacy_arm_axis: Initial local exploration only: AXIS_START=[0.29,0.02,1.42], AXIS_END=[0.42,0.025,1.025]; retained as provenance, not bind coordinates.

rig_mapping.UpperArm_R: shoulder to elbow; rigid shoulder spaulder and upper-arm lame
rig_mapping.ElbowSupport_R: helper rest head at elbow; central sleeve weights and extensor couter
rig_mapping.Forearm_R: elbow to wrist; forearm lames and wrist cuff

source_truth.helper_pose: Standalone poses rotate ElbowSupport_R halfway about the averaged local lateral axis through the exact elbow pivot. Full-body assembly should derive the helper world transform from the existing UpperArm_R and Forearm_R clip transforms without changing their established curves.
source_truth.hand_interface: WristCuff overlaps the Hand_R wrist head by approximately 8 mm. The right hand remains the previously grip-approved separate asset.

mode_inference_decision.rationale: Local character arm shape and skinning review; no runtime publication before full character visual acceptance.

acceptance.quad_cage_and_pose_unit_tests: 5 passed; high-detail cage, LOD0 triangle budget, exact joints, cuff overlap, and closed sleeve checks included.
acceptance.browser_parity_status: Pass across neutral, bend75, bend90, bend120, roll45, and return-neutral; tolerance 0.00002 m.
acceptance.visual_arm_quality: Root integration lead approved standalone 90-degree and 120-degree front/side/back Blender views for assembly. Actual GLB views were also inspected; the sleeve remains closed and continuous, with the full-body view pending.
